R02.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    4 AS sort_no,
    CAST('R02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('未签单商机预测金额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_count
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('订单明细连接到实际订单头；按去重订单ID计数，0个未签。金额/电量分开累计；关联明细是期间有预测的商机。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        '产品汇总',
        (
          SELECT
            JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
          FROM base_values AS v
        ),
        '签单关联明细',
        (
          SELECT
            JSONB_AGG(
              JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', o.opportunity_id, '关联订单数', o.order_count, '已签单', o.signed)
            )
          FROM opportunity_flags AS o
          JOIN opportunity_forecast AS f
            USING (opportunity_id)
        )
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM base_values AS b
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R03.name: 签单进度与时间进度差
R03.definition: 金额口径已签单覆盖率＝已签单商机预测金额÷商机预测总金额；电量口径＝已签单商机预测电量÷商机预测总电量。未签比例＝对应未签预测÷总预测。时间进度＝已过去天数÷全年天数。R03＝覆盖率－时间进度。分子、分母采用相同期间、产品及页面维度范围。
R03.formula: 逐日：已签单商机预测覆盖率低于时间进度判风险。季度窗口：7–9月未签单商机预测占比超过50%、10–12月超过25%判风险。阈值保持原值；比例分母改为商机预测总额，不再将目标缺口加入未签比例。总预测为空或为0时结果NULL。
R03.caliber: 已有年度时间消耗；未发现直接输出“签单进度－时间进度差”的指标或季度50%/25%判定。
R03.attributes: （由其他指标计算；SQL 读取字段见“指标SQL计算步骤”）
R03.dashboardSql: 已有年度时间消耗；未发现直接输出“签单进度－时间进度差”的指标或季度50%/25%判定。
R03.notes: 2026-11-14按用户确认修订：金额、电量覆盖率均直接使用已签预测÷商机预测总额；金额、电量独立计算，不以0替代未知。年度目标仅用于独立缺口与目标达成分析。
R03.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
R03.role: 风险触发 / 行动跟踪
R03.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → forecasts_by_product → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → targets_by_product → base_values
R03.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  5 AS sort_no,
  CAST('R03' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('签单进度与时间进度差' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    b.signed_progress_amount - p.time_progress
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('金额/电量已签单覆盖率＝对应已签单商机预测÷商机预测总额；覆盖率减年度时间进度为进度差。季度未签比例不再包含目标缺口。总预测为NULL或0时覆盖率NULL；金额、电量独立计算。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '金额签单进度',
      b.signed_progress_amount,
      '电量签单进度',
      b.signed_progress_energy,
      '时间进度',
      p.time_progress,
      '电量进度差',
      b.signed_progress_energy - p.time_progress,
      '金额未签单商机预测占比',
      b.unsigned_amount / NULLIF(b.total_amount, 0),
      '季度阈值',
      CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.cutoff - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND') BETWEEN 10 AND 12
        THEN 0.25
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.cutoff - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND') BETWEEN 7 AND 9
        THEN 0.50
      END
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM base_values AS b
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R04.name: 重点跟踪未签单商机数与预测金额／电量
R04.definition: 储能客户名单内，战略1和重点2的未签单商机为重点跟踪。按商机ID去重并汇总所选期间预测金额/电量，按电芯/PACK拆分；签单仍由订单明细关联真实订单判断。
R04.formula: 同口径商机预测缺口（R01）大于 0，且战略客户和重点客户的未签单商机数量大于 0、对应预测金额或电量大于 0 时，判为风险。
R04.caliber: 已有商机数及客户等级、签单维度；没有独立输出战略＋重点未签商机数、金额、电量并应用R01风险条件的指标。
R04.attributes:
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
R04.physicalFields: 储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
R04.dashboardSql: 已有商机数及客户等级、签单维度；没有独立输出战略＋重点未签商机数、金额、电量并应用R01风险条件的指标。
R04.notes: 储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不限创建年份。原有计数对象及时间、签单、预测规则不变。
R04.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
R04.role: 风险触发 / 行动跟踪
R04.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → forecasts_by_product → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → targets_by_product → base_values
R04.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  6 AS sort_no,
  CAST('R04' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('重点跟踪未签单商机数与预测金额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    b.focus_amount
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    b.focus_energy
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    b.focus_count
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('储能客户名单内，战略1和重点2的未签单商机为重点跟踪。按商机ID去重并汇总所选期间预测金额/电量，按电芯/PACK拆分；签单仍由订单明细关联真实订单判断。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
      FROM base_values AS v
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM base_values AS b
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R05.name: 电芯类待签商机预测金额／电量
R05.definition: 汇总电芯类的年度目标、商机总预测和待签预测。金额与电量分别计算。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
R05.formula: 该类待签预测大于 0，且满足以下任一条件时判为风险。①该类总预测低于年度目标。②按 R03 判定该类签单进度落后。条件①继续使用年度目标；条件②按同产品已签预测÷商机预测总额计算金额/电量覆盖率。
R05.caliber: 已有产品类型、签单分组预测；未发现电芯类年度目标不足或签单进度落后的整套独立风险判定。

R05.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
