    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    7 AS sort_no,
    CAST('R05' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('电芯类待签商机预测金额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_count
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('分产品待签预测；目标不足或签单进度落后规则，金额/电量独立。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      TO_JSONB(b) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        '金额风险',
        b.unsigned_amount > 0
        AND (
          b.gap_amount > 0 OR b.signed_progress_amount < p.time_progress
        ),
        '电量风险',
        b.unsigned_energy > 0
        AND (
          b.gap_energy > 0 OR b.signed_progress_energy < p.time_progress
        )
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN base_values AS b
    ON b.product_type = '电芯'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R06.name: PACK 类待签商机预测金额／电量
R06.definition: 汇总 PACK 类的年度目标、商机总预测和待签预测。金额与电量分别计算。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
R06.formula: 该类待签预测大于 0，且满足以下任一条件时判为风险。①该类总预测低于年度目标。②按 R03 判定该类签单进度落后。条件①继续使用年度目标；条件②按同产品已签预测÷商机预测总额计算金额/电量覆盖率。
R06.caliber: 已有产品类型、签单分组预测；未发现PACK类年度目标不足或签单进度落后的整套独立风险判定。
R06.attributes:
LE01-A0044 商机管理.客户需求产品类型（new_accproducttype，空 0.07%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE12-A0005 产品类型.客户需求产品类型（new_accproducttype，空 0%）
R06.physicalFields: 商机.new_accproducttype；预测金额/Wh单价；目标月金额/电量
R06.dashboardSql: 已有产品类型、签单分组预测；未发现PACK类年度目标不足或签单进度落后的整套独立风险判定。
R06.notes: 原始指标可复用，完整风险需按同产品范围衍生。
R06.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
R06.role: 风险触发 / 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
R06.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → forecasts_by_product → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → targets_by_product → base_values
R06.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    8 AS sort_no,
    CAST('R06' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('PACK 类待签商机预测金额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      b.unsigned_count
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('分产品待签预测；目标不足或签单进度落后规则，金额/电量独立。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      TO_JSONB(b) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        '金额风险',
        b.unsigned_amount > 0
        AND (
          b.gap_amount > 0 OR b.signed_progress_amount < p.time_progress
        ),
        '电量风险',
        b.unsigned_energy > 0
        AND (
          b.gap_energy > 0 OR b.signed_progress_energy < p.time_progress
        )
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN base_values AS b
    ON b.product_type = 'PACK'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R08.name: 客户目标、商机预测及缺口
R08.definition: 仅储能客户名单内，按客户ID＋产品类型对齐年度目标与所选期间预测，分别计算目标－预测。客户没有商机也可在名单中；目标版本、金额/电量单位及单侧缺失NULL规则沿本文件。
R08.formula:
有商机且缺口大于 0，判为预测不足。无商机战略客户按 R09 判定。
目标只去重版本，不按客户或产品删减不同商机；目标或预测缺失仍按原规则保留NULL。
R08.caliber: 客户表单位MWh。名为“客户商机预测缺口电量”的YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP实际返回已签＋未签预测合计，未减目标；“客户电量缺口”则是目标－实际发货。两者均不能直接当R08预测缺口。
R08.attributes:
LE01-A0044 商机管理.客户需求产品类型（new_accproducttype，空 0.07%）
LE01-A0476 商机管理.客户（parentaccountid，空 0%）
LE02-A0039 项目月度销售预测.预测订单金额(未税/人民币)（new_forecast_amt_rmb，空 0%）
LE02-A0052 项目月度销售预测.瓦时单价(国内含税/海外未税)（new_whprice，空 3.74%）
LE06-A0038 销售目标管理.客户（new_account_id，空 0%）
LE06-A0054 销售目标管理.产品类型（new_producttype_id，空 0%）
LE12-A0001 产品类型.主键（new_product_typeid，空 0%）
LE12-A0005 产品类型.客户需求产品类型（new_accproducttype，空 0%）
R08.physicalFields:
目标.new_account_id/new_producttype_id及月金额/月power；产品类型.new_product_typeid/new_accproducttype；商机.parentaccountid/new_accproducttype；预测.new_forecast_amt_rmb/new_whprice
储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
R08.dashboardSql: 客户表单位MWh。名为“客户商机预测缺口电量”的YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP实际返回已签＋未签预测合计，未减目标；“客户电量缺口”则是目标－实际发货。两者均不能直接当R08预测缺口。
R08.notes: 储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不限创建年份。原有计数对象及时间、签单、预测规则不变。
R08.sqlStatus: 已按客户和产品拆分；缺口完整性见明细
R08.role: 风险触发 / 行动跟踪
R08.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → customer_target → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → customer_forecast → customer_gaps
R08.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), customer_target AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    account_id,
    product_type
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), customer_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS forecast_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS forecast_energy
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    account_id,
    product_type
), customer_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  k.account_id,
  a.account_name,
  k.product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  f.forecast_amount,
  t.target_amount - f.forecast_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  f.forecast_energy,
  t.target_energy - f.forecast_energy AS gap_energy
FROM (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    product_type
  FROM customer_target
  WHERE
    account_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    account_id,
    product_type
  FROM customer_forecast
  WHERE
    account_id IS NOT NULL
) AS k
JOIN accounts AS a
  ON a.account_id = k.account_id
LEFT JOIN customer_target AS t
  ON t.account_id = k.account_id AND t.product_type = k.product_type
LEFT JOIN customer_forecast AS f
  ON f.account_id = k.account_id AND f.product_type = k.product_type
WHERE
  a.account_id IN (
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM storage_customer_ids
  )
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  9 AS sort_no,
  CAST('R08' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('客户目标、商机预测及缺口' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    SUM(g.gap_amount)
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    SUM(g.gap_energy)
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    COUNT(*)
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('已按客户和产品拆分；缺口完整性见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('仅储能客户名单内，按客户ID＋产品类型对齐年度目标与所选期间预测，分别计算目标－预测。客户没有商机也可在名单中；目标版本、金额/电量单位及单侧缺失NULL规则沿本文件。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(g))
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM customer_gaps AS g
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R09.name: 待突破的战略客户数
R09.definition: 以储能客户名单为底表，客户等级默认1；accountid＝商机parentaccountid关联全部最新商机。关联商机数为0的客户，按客户ID去重统计。客户本身不必已有商机，不按客户创建年份、审核或预测存在性筛选。
R09.formula: 战略客户的商机数为 0 时，列为待突破。待突破战略客户数大于 0 时，判为风险。
R09.caliber: 客户等级0/核心大客户及1/战略大客户中，不存在new_opportunitystatus=0在跟商机的客户，按客户ID去重；还按客户.createdon落所选期间。
R09.attributes:
LE01-A0001 商机管理.主键（opportunityid，空 0%）
LE01-A0476 商机管理.客户（parentaccountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0001 客户.主键（accountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0244 客户.客户等级（new_accountlevel，空 0%）
R09.physicalFields:
客户.accountid/new_accountlevel；商机.opportunityid/parentaccountid
储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
R09.dashboardSql: 客户等级0/核心大客户及1/战略大客户中，不存在new_opportunitystatus=0在跟商机的客户，按客户ID去重；还按客户.createdon落所选期间。
R09.notes: 储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不限创建年份。数量按客户ID去重。
R09.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
R09.role: 风险触发 / 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
R09.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → customer_coverage
R09.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), customer_coverage AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.account_name,
  a.level_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    o.product_type = '电芯') AS cell_opportunity_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    o.product_type = 'PACK') AS pack_opportunity_count
FROM accounts AS a
CROSS JOIN context AS p
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
  ON o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.rn = 1
WHERE
  a.level_code = ANY(
    p.strategic_levels
  )
  AND a.account_id IN (
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM storage_customer_ids
  )
GROUP BY
  a.account_id,
  a.account_name,
  a.level_code
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  10 AS sort_no,
  CAST('R09' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('待突破的战略客户数' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      c.opportunity_count = 0)
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST((
    '已实现；客户底表按关联商机数判定'
  ) AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('以储能客户名单为底表，客户等级默认1；accountid＝商机parentaccountid关联全部最新商机。关联商机数为0的客户，按客户ID去重统计。客户本身不必已有商机，不按客户创建年份、审核或预测存在性筛选。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '战略客户总数',
      COUNT(*),
      '有商机客户',
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        opportunity_count > 0),
      '无商机客户',
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        opportunity_count = 0),
      '客户明细',
      JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(c))
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM customer_coverage AS c
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C01.name: 处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量
C01.definition: 客户须在储能名单且等级1；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0，经订单明细未关联到真实订单。数量按商机ID去重，预测金额/电量按本文件原所选期间最新预测规则汇总；缺预测不影响商机数量。
C01.formula: 数量不依赖预测记录存在；预测金额与电量分别计算。此指标不再以需求未确认作为额外取值过滤，需求确认情况可另作原因下钻。
C01.attributes:
LE01-A0001 商机管理.主键（opportunityid，空 0%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0476 商机管理.客户（parentaccountid，空 0%）
LE01-A0488 商机管理.状态（statecode，空 0%）
LE02-A0039 项目月度销售预测.预测订单金额(未税/人民币)（new_forecast_amt_rmb，空 0%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE02-A0052 项目月度销售预测.瓦时单价(国内含税/海外未税)（new_whprice，空 3.74%）
LE02-A0057 项目月度销售预测.预测年月(用于排序与过滤)（new_accountdate，空 0%）
LE05-A0001 客户.主键（accountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0244 客户.客户等级（new_accountlevel，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
C01.physicalFields:
商机.opportunityid/new_processstage/statecode/parentaccountid；客户.accountid/new_accountlevel；订单明细.new_opportunity_id/salesorderid；订单.salesorderid；月度预测.new_opportunity_id/new_accountdate/new_forecast_amt_rmb/new_whprice
储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
C01.notes: 储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不限创建年份。原有计数对象及时间、签单、预测规则不变。
C01.sqlStatus: 已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算
C01.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C01.ctes: parameters → context → forecast_rows → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → strategic_p0_unsigned → strategic_p0_values
C01.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), strategic_p0_unsigned AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  o.opportunity_id,
  o.product_type,
  a.account_id
FROM opportunity_rows AS o
JOIN accounts AS a
  ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
  ON s.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  (
    o.rn = 1
    AND o.process_stage = '11'
    AND o.system_state = '0'
    AND a.level_code = ANY(
      p.strategic_levels
    )
    AND COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
  )
  AND a.account_id IN (
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM storage_customer_ids
  )
), strategic_p0_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(c.product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE c.product_type END AS product_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS amount_yi,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0)) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) AS forecast_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.forecast_id IS NULL) AS opportunities_without_period_forecast,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price = 0) AS missing_energy_input_rows
  FROM strategic_p0_unsigned AS c
  LEFT JOIN forecast_rows AS f
    ON f.opportunity_id = c.opportunity_id AND f.rn = 1
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        c.product_type
      )
    )
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  13 AS sort_no,
  CAST('C01' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  amount_yi,
  energy_gwh,
  CAST(opportunity_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('客户须在储能名单且等级1；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0，经订单明细未关联到真实订单。数量按商机ID去重，预测金额/电量按本文件原所选期间最新预测规则汇总；缺预测不影响商机数量。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  (
    SELECT
      JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
    FROM strategic_p0_values AS x
  ) AS detail
FROM strategic_p0_values
WHERE
  product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C07.name: 方案推动超平均周期 50% 的未签单商机
C07.definition: 筛选当前仍在方案推动（P2）、且尚未签单的商机。在途用时为测量日减 P2 进入日。动态平均周期引用P2-01的已结束样本均值，在途不计入该均值。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
C07.formula: 如未签单商机仍处于 P2，且实际在途用时严格大于 P2 动态平均周期的 1.5 倍，则判定“方案推动超期”原因成立。按电芯、PACK 匹配风险 2 的待签商机，统计受影响预测金额和电量。等于 1.5 倍时不触发。
C07.attributes:
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
