C03.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,
    COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb AS s
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < LEAST(CAST(p.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP), p.observed_at)
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = l.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS t
    ON t.owner_id = o.owner_id
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid
      ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb AS i
  WHERE
    i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty > 0
), shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    i.line_id,
    t.team_name,
    i.amount_yi,
    i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM shipment_rows AS i
  JOIN shipment_headers AS s
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  LEFT JOIN order_teams AS t
    USING (order_id)
  WHERE
    i.rn = 1 AND s.statecode = 0
), actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM shipment_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.team_name, '未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
    SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) - SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
    SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) - SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
    CAST(SUM(target_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS target_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(actual_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_energy_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows,
    BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
  FROM (
    SELECT
      team_name,
      target_amount,
      target_energy,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_amount,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_energy,
      target_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
      target_amount_nonnull_rows,
      target_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      target_missing_amount_rows,
      target_missing_energy_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows
    FROM target_teams
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      team_name,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      actual_amount,
      actual_energy,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      missing_amount_rows,
      missing_energy_rows
    FROM actual_teams
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.team_name
), c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
    linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
    sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
    linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
    (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name
    )
    AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
  FROM target_rows AS t
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    ON ot.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS sizes
    ON sizes.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = t.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS linked
    ON linked.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS linked_sizes
    ON linked_sizes.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
), c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_target_assignment
      WHERE
        team_paths_differ
    ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM target_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM shipment_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_owner_team_sizes
      WHERE
        candidate_team_count > 1
    ) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM c0_target_assignment
        WHERE
          team_paths_differ
        ORDER BY
          target_id
        LIMIT 50
      ) AS x
    ) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    16 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('产品部年度销售目标' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.team_name AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(t.target_amount AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(t.target_energy AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST((
      CASE
        WHEN target_amount_nonnull_rows = 0 AND target_energy_nonnull_rows = 0
        THEN '有目标记录，但核心计算字段全空'
        WHEN target_missing_amount_rows > 0 OR target_missing_energy_rows > 0
        THEN '目标字段部分缺失；当前为已知值合计'
        ELSE '已有目标记录并可计算'
      END
    ) AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    TO_JSONB(t) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('团队归属核对', (
      SELECT
        TO_JSONB(q)
      FROM c0_team_assignment_audit AS q
    )) AS detail
  FROM team_gaps AS t
  WHERE
    target_record_count > 0
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C04.name: 产品部累计实际销售额／电量
C04.definition: 以产品团队为维度，汇总所选年度/期间截至观察日的实际销售额和实际销售电量。团队与C03保持同一名称范围，同一团队一行。 仅列出实际有实绩事实记录的团队。
C04.formula: 累计实际销售作为产品部差距判定的实绩依据。与 C03 的年度目标使用同年度、产品部及统计范围，按 C05 判定该产品部的销售缺口是否成立。
C04.caliber: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.attributes:
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE16-A0017 发货单.实际发货日期（new_shipping2_date，空 0%）
LE17-A0008 发货单明细.交货数量（new_qty，空 0%）
LE17-A0012 发货单明细.物料编码（new_productcode，空 0%）
LE17-A0022 发货单明细.总金额(基础货币)（new_amount_base，空 0%）
LE18-A0031 产品物料.系统能量kWh（new_system_energy，空 38.81%）
LE18-A0095 产品物料.物料编码（productnumber，空 0%）
C04.dashboardSql: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 团队维度查找不再额外按商机创建年份截断，实际销售事实仍按发货期间筛选；同一订单有归属不明商机时不强行分给已知团队。 引用ID未匹配到商机的明细也视为团队归属不明。
C04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C04.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C04.ctes: parameters → context → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → target_teams → shipment_headers → product_codes → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C04.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,
    COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb AS s
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < LEAST(CAST(p.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP), p.observed_at)
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = l.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS t
    ON t.owner_id = o.owner_id
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid
      ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb AS i
  WHERE
    i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty > 0
), shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    i.line_id,
    t.team_name,
    i.amount_yi,
    i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM shipment_rows AS i
  JOIN shipment_headers AS s
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  LEFT JOIN order_teams AS t
    USING (order_id)
  WHERE
    i.rn = 1 AND s.statecode = 0
), actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM shipment_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.team_name, '未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
    SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) - SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
    SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) - SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
    CAST(SUM(target_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS target_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(actual_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_energy_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows,
    BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
  FROM (
    SELECT
      team_name,
      target_amount,
      target_energy,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_amount,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_energy,
      target_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
      target_amount_nonnull_rows,
      target_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      target_missing_amount_rows,
      target_missing_energy_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows
    FROM target_teams
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      team_name,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      actual_amount,
      actual_energy,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      missing_amount_rows,
      missing_energy_rows
    FROM actual_teams
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.team_name
), c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
    linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
    sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
    linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
    (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name
    )
    AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
  FROM target_rows AS t
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    ON ot.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS sizes
    ON sizes.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = t.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS linked
    ON linked.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS linked_sizes
    ON linked_sizes.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
), c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_target_assignment
      WHERE
        team_paths_differ
    ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM target_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM shipment_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_owner_team_sizes
      WHERE
        candidate_team_count > 1
    ) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM c0_target_assignment
        WHERE
          team_paths_differ
        ORDER BY
          target_id
        LIMIT 50
      ) AS x
    ) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    17 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('产品部累计实际销售额／电量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.team_name AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(t.actual_amount AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(t.actual_energy AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST((
      CASE
        WHEN actual_amount_nonnull_rows = 0 AND actual_energy_nonnull_rows = 0
        THEN '有实绩记录，但核心计算字段全空'
        WHEN missing_amount_rows > 0 OR missing_energy_rows > 0
        THEN '实绩字段部分缺失；当前为已知值合计'
        ELSE '已有实绩记录并可计算'
      END
    ) AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    TO_JSONB(t) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('团队归属核对', (
      SELECT
        TO_JSONB(q)
      FROM c0_team_assignment_audit AS q
    )) AS detail
  FROM team_gaps AS t
  WHERE
    actual_record_count > 0
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C05.name: 产品部实际销售与目标差距
C05.definition: 按同一产品团队逐项计算C04实际销售－C03年度目标，金额和电量分别计算；小于0代表该团队不足。
C05.formula: 如同一产品部的累计实际销售减年度目标小于 0，则判定“该产品部存在销售缺口”成立。金额、电量分别判断。关联风险 2 时，须匹配该产品部的电芯或 PACK 待签商机。差距用于定位缺口归属，具体推进卡点按 C07 核实。
C05.caliber: 已有按团队目标与实际的基础输出；未发现独立输出实际－目标的C05指标。
C05.attributes: （由其他指标计算；SQL 读取字段见“指标SQL计算步骤”）
C05.dashboardSql: 已有按团队目标与实际的基础输出；未发现独立输出实际－目标的C05指标。
C05.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 当目标或实绩团队仅在一侧出现时，记录数会明确为0，不能仅凭此就认定源字段全空。
C05.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C05.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C05.ctes: parameters → context → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → target_teams → shipment_headers → product_codes → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C05.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,
    COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb AS s
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < LEAST(CAST(p.end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP), p.observed_at)
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = l.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS t
    ON t.owner_id = o.owner_id
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid
      ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb AS i
  WHERE
    i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty > 0
), shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    i.line_id,
    t.team_name,
    i.amount_yi,
    i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM shipment_rows AS i
  JOIN shipment_headers AS s
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  LEFT JOIN order_teams AS t
    USING (order_id)
  WHERE
    i.rn = 1 AND s.statecode = 0
), actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM shipment_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.team_name, '未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
    SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) - SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
    SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) - SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
    CAST(SUM(target_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS target_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(actual_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_energy_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows,
    BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
  FROM (
    SELECT
      team_name,
      target_amount,
      target_energy,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_amount,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_energy,
      target_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
      target_amount_nonnull_rows,
      target_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      target_missing_amount_rows,
      target_missing_energy_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows
    FROM target_teams
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      team_name,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      actual_amount,
      actual_energy,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      missing_amount_rows,
      missing_energy_rows
    FROM actual_teams
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.team_name
), c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
    linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
    sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
    linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
    (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name
    )
    AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
  FROM target_rows AS t
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    ON ot.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS sizes
    ON sizes.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = t.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS linked
    ON linked.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS linked_sizes
    ON linked_sizes.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
), c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_target_assignment
      WHERE
        team_paths_differ
    ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM target_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM shipment_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_owner_team_sizes
      WHERE
        candidate_team_count > 1
    ) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM c0_target_assignment
        WHERE
          team_paths_differ
        ORDER BY
          target_id
        LIMIT 50
      ) AS x
    ) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    18 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C05' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('产品部实际销售与目标差距' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.team_name AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(t.gap_amount AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(t.gap_energy AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST((
      CASE
        WHEN target_record_count = 0
        THEN '未查到同名团队年度目标；不可算差额'
        WHEN actual_record_count = 0
        THEN '所选期间未查到同名团队实绩；不可算差额'
        WHEN gap_amount IS NULL AND gap_energy IS NULL
        THEN '两侧有记录，但无可配对计算字段'
        WHEN target_missing_amount_rows > 0
        OR target_missing_energy_rows > 0
        OR missing_amount_rows > 0
        OR missing_energy_rows > 0
        THEN '两侧部分字段缺失；差额为已知值之差'
        ELSE '目标与实绩已配对'
      END
    ) AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    TO_JSONB(t) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('团队归属核对', (
      SELECT
        TO_JSONB(q)
      FROM c0_team_assignment_audit AS q
    )) AS detail
  FROM team_gaps AS t
  WHERE
    TRUE
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C08.name: 重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例
C08.definition: 分子为储能客户名单内的R04重点跟踪未签预测，分母沿R02全部未签单商机预测；金额、电量分别按原规则计算。客户名单仅调整分子所属客户范围。
C08.formula: 如分母大于 0，且重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例严格低于 70%，则判定“重点跟踪商机承接不足”这一原因成立。等于 70% 时本项不成立。分母为 0 时不计算比例。
C08.attributes:
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
C08.physicalFields: 储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
C08.notes: 储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不限创建年份。原有计数对象及时间、签单、预测规则不变。
C08.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
C08.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C08.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → forecasts_by_product → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → targets_by_product → base_values
C08.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  19 AS sort_no,
  CAST('C08' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    b.focus_amount / NULLIF(b.unsigned_amount, 0)
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('分子为储能客户名单内的R04重点跟踪未签预测，分母沿R02全部未签单商机预测；金额、电量分别按原规则计算。客户名单仅调整分子所属客户范围。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '金额占比',
      b.focus_amount / NULLIF(b.unsigned_amount, 0),
      '电量占比',
      b.focus_energy / NULLIF(b.unsigned_energy, 0)
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM base_values AS b
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C06.name: 其余未签单商机中 P0 需求未确认的商机数及预测量
C06.definition: 客户须在储能名单且不属于重点等级1/2；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0、订单明细无真实订单、new_demandinput=0。按商机ID计数，预测缺失不阻断数量。
C06.formula: 如其余未签单商机预测占全部未签单预测的比例大于或等于 30%，且其中存在仍处于 P0、需求确认未完成的商机，数量及对应预测金额或电量大于 0，则判定“其余商机需求未确认”这一原因成立。金额、电量分别判断。
C06.attributes:
LE01-A0185 商机管理.客户需求输入（new_demandinput，空 0%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0488 商机管理.状态（statecode，空 0%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE05-A0244 客户.客户等级（new_accountlevel，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）

-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT

    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,

    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
