    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,

), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (

      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,

    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,

      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE

    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), c06_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  o.opportunity_id,
  o.product_type,
  o.demand_status
FROM opportunity_rows AS o
JOIN accounts AS a
  ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
  ON s.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  (
    o.rn = 1
    AND o.process_stage = '11'
    AND o.system_state = '0'
    AND a.level_code IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT (
      a.level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
  )
  AND a.account_id IN (
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM storage_customer_ids
  )
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), c06_cohort AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM c06_candidates
  WHERE
    demand_status = '0'
), c06_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(c.product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE c.product_type END AS product_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS amount_yi,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0)) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) AS forecast_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.forecast_id IS NULL) AS opportunities_without_period_forecast,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price = 0) AS missing_energy_input_rows
  FROM c06_cohort AS c
  LEFT JOIN forecast_rows AS f
    ON f.opportunity_id = c.opportunity_id AND f.rn = 1
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        c.product_type
      )
    )
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  20 AS sort_no,
  CAST('C06' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('其余未签单商机中 P0 需求未确认的商机数及预测量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  amount_yi,
  energy_gwh,
  CAST(opportunity_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('已按需求输入Boolean完成标志实现；预测缺失不挡数量' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('客户须在储能名单且不属于重点等级1/2；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0、订单明细无真实订单、new_demandinput=0。按商机ID计数，预测缺失不阻断数量。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
    '产品分组',
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
      FROM c06_values AS v
    ),
    '基础候选数',
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c06_candidates
    ),
    '已完成需求输入数',
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c06_candidates
      WHERE
        demand_status = '1'
    ),
    '需求输入状态未知数',
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c06_candidates
      WHERE
        demand_status IS NULL OR NOT demand_status IN ('0', '1')
    ),
    '风险阈值说明',
    '其余预测占未签预测至少30%为原因判定规则，不阻止此基础指标取值'
  ) AS detail
FROM c06_values
WHERE
  product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      owner_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
          ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          owner_id
        FROM storage_opportunity_owners
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
    WHERE
      CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
        SELECT
          team_id
        FROM storage_team_ids
      )
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.accountid
        ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    account_id
  FROM customer_latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
      SELECT
        user_id
      FROM storage_user_ids
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
  SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
  SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      signed)
  END AS signed_energy,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed)
  END AS unsigned_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      ))
  END AS focus_energy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
    (
      NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
        p.focus_levels
      )
    )
    AND account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )) AS focus_count,
  COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts
CROSS JOIN context AS p
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (),
    (
      product_type
    )
  )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
  t.target_amount,
  t.target_energy,
  t.target_missing_amount_rows,
  t.target_missing_energy_rows,
  f.total_amount,
  f.total_energy,
  f.signed_amount,
  f.signed_energy,
  f.unsigned_amount,
  f.unsigned_energy,
  f.focus_amount,
  f.focus_energy,
  f.unsigned_count,
  f.focus_count,
  f.fact_rows,
  f.missing_amount_rows,
  f.missing_energy_rows,
  t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
  t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
  f.signed_amount / NULLIF(f.total_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
  f.signed_energy / NULLIF(f.total_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
FROM targets_by_product AS t
FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
  USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  21 AS sort_no,
  CAST('C09' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('其余未签单商机预测金额／电量及占比' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    b.unsigned_amount - b.focus_amount
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    b.unsigned_energy - b.focus_energy
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    (
      b.unsigned_amount - b.focus_amount
    ) / NULLIF(b.unsigned_amount, 0)
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('沿原关系：其余预测＝R02全部未签预测－R04重点跟踪未签预测。R04重点跟踪客户限定储能名单；其余金额、电量与分母、缺值规则沿本文件，不把其余一律称一般客户。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('电量占比', (
      b.unsigned_energy - b.focus_energy
    ) / NULLIF(b.unsigned_energy, 0))
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM base_values AS b
CROSS JOIN context AS p
WHERE
  b.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P0-01.name: 商机获取阶段平均周期
P0-01.definition: 统计实际经历过P0且有完整起止时间的商机，不限制当前new_processstage。周期＝商机.new_stage1enddate－createdon，换算天取平均；缺起点、缺本阶段结束或结束早于开始均不参与本阶段平均及样本数量。按进入本阶段时间归所选期间；跨年结束按实际完整周期。总体及电芯/PACK分开计算。
P0-01.formula: 单笔周期严格大于同阶段同产品已结束样本平均周期的1.5倍判超期。未结束商机不参与基准均值，可单独按观察截止日在途时长比较该均值；没有有效均值时不取固定值兜底。
P0-01.caliber: 看板商机获取平均周期＝createdon至new_stage5enddate，只取已完成记录，按结束日期归期；没有按电芯/PACK分组。
P0-01.attributes:
LE01-A0101 商机管理.阶段一结束日期（new_stage1enddate，空 63.04%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0490 商机管理.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE05-A0295 客户.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
P0-01.physicalFields: 商机.createdon→new_stage1enddate；不要求当前new_processstage为本阶段枚举
P0-01.dashboardSql: 看板商机获取平均周期＝createdon至new_stage5enddate，只取已完成记录，按结束日期归期；没有按电芯/PACK分组。
P0-01.notes: 数量列＝参与平均周期的完整有效起止商机数。缺某阶段结束只排除该阶段，不整条商机剔除；已完成的前序/其他阶段仍可计算。当前阶段枚举不用于补造日期。
P0-01.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P0-01.role: 风险触发 / 根因判定
P0-01.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → stage_facts → stage_means
P0-01.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,

SELECT
  o.*,
  v.stage_code,
  v.started_at,
  v.finished_at,
  (
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at, p.cutoff), p.cutoff) - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  ) AS elapsed_days,
  v.started_at >= p.start_date AND v.started_at < p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
  v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at > p.cutoff AS inflight,
  v.started_at IS NULL
  OR (
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at < v.started_at
  ) AS invalid_dates,
  CASE
    WHEN v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at >= v.started_at
    THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      v.finished_at - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  END AS completed_days
FROM opportunity_flags AS o

  VALUES

    ('P2', o.s2, o.s3),
    ('P3', o.s3, o.s4),
    ('P4', o.s4, o.s5)
) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
WHERE
  v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at <= p.cutoff

  product_type,
  AVG(completed_days) AS mean_days,
  COUNT(completed_days) AS sample_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts
WHERE
  in_window
GROUP BY
  stage_code,
  product_type

  CAST((

      FROM stage_means AS t
      WHERE
        stage_code = 'P0'
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM stage_facts AS f
WHERE
  stage_code = 'P0' AND in_window

SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P0-02.name: 商机获取阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量
P0-02.definition: 按阶段筛出实际周期大于动态平均周期 1.5 倍的商机。以商机 ID 去重后汇总预测金额和电量，细分电芯与 PACK。
P0-02.formula: 只汇总本阶段满足超期条件的商机。同一商机在同一阶段只计算一次。
P0-02.attributes:
LE01-A0101 商机管理.阶段一结束日期（new_stage1enddate，空 63.04%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0490 商机管理.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE02-A0020 项目月度销售预测.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE05-A0295 客户.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
P0-02.notes: 阶段均值只含完整有效起止的已结束样本，不含在途。超过均值1.5倍的预测量独立统计；在途实际用时仍可按观察截止计算并比较已结束样本均值。

    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  o.*,
  v.stage_code,
  v.started_at,
  v.finished_at,
  (
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at, p.cutoff), p.cutoff) - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  ) AS elapsed_days,
  v.started_at >= p.start_date AND v.started_at < p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
  v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at > p.cutoff AS inflight,
  v.started_at IS NULL
  OR (
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at < v.started_at
  ) AS invalid_dates,
  CASE
    WHEN v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at >= v.started_at
    THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      v.finished_at - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  END AS completed_days
FROM opportunity_flags AS o
CROSS JOIN context AS p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('P0', o.created_at, o.s1),
    ('P1', o.s1, o.s2),
    ('P2', o.s2, o.s3),
    ('P3', o.s3, o.s4),
    ('P4', o.s4, o.s5)
) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
WHERE
  v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at <= p.cutoff
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  stage_code,
  product_type,
  AVG(completed_days) AS mean_days,
  COUNT(completed_days) AS sample_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts
WHERE
  in_window
GROUP BY
  stage_code,
  product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    m.mean_days,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    f.elapsed_days > 1.5 * m.mean_days AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts AS f
  JOIN stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    23 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P0-02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('商机获取阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('超过同阶段同产品均值1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', opportunity_id, '产品', product_type, '周期天', elapsed_days, '均值天', mean_days)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P0' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P0-03.name: 签保密协议平均周期
P0-03.definition: 商机.new_cdaenddate－商机.new_cdastartdate，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P0-03.formula: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P0-03.attributes:
LE01-A0115 商机管理.保密协议结束日期（new_cdaenddate，空 100%）
LE01-A0153 商机管理.保密协议开始日期（new_cdastartdate，空 100%）
LE05-A0208 客户.保密协议结束日期（new_cdaenddate，空 99.32%）
LE05-A0229 客户.保密协议开始日期（new_cdastartdate，空 99.12%）

开始：商机.new_cdastartdate
结束：商机.new_cdaenddate

P0-03.notes: 保密协议继续使用已确认的商机表独立开始/结束日期。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。 客户表保密日期仍作独立对照，不静默覆盖本指标的商机表日期。
P0-03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P0-03.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → account_time_diagnostics
P0-03.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.started_at >= p.start_date
    AND n.started_at < p.end_exclusive
    AND n.started_at <= p.cutoff AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      AND finished_at <= cutoff
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND entered_at IS NOT NULL
      AND entered_at <= cutoff
      AND (
        finished_at > cutoff OR (
          finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag
        )
      )
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        cutoff - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    in_window
    AND event_id IS NOT NULL
    AND finished_at >= started_at
    AND finished_at <= cutoff AS completed_valid,
    in_window
    AND event_id IS NOT NULL
    AND entered_at IS NOT NULL
    AND entered_at <= cutoff
    AND (
      finished_at > cutoff OR (
        finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag
      )
    ) AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), account_time_diagnostics AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS linked_customer_count,
    COUNT(a.sap_created_at) AS sap_creation_date_present,
    COUNT(a.sap_submitted_at) AS sap_submission_date_present,
    COUNT(a.account_factory_approved_at) AS factory_approval_date_present,
    COUNT(a.account_cda_start) AS customer_cda_start_present,
    COUNT(a.account_cda_end) AS customer_cda_end_present,
    COUNT(a.account_sinosure_start) AS sinosure_start_present,
    COUNT(a.account_sinosure_end) AS sinosure_end_present,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      a.sap_submitted_at >= p.start_date
      AND a.sap_submitted_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.sap_created_at >= a.sap_submitted_at
      AND a.sap_created_at <= p.cutoff) AS sap_internal_valid_pairs,
    AVG(
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        a.sap_created_at - a.sap_submitted_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    ) FILTER(WHERE
      a.sap_submitted_at >= p.start_date
      AND a.sap_submitted_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.sap_created_at >= a.sap_submitted_at
      AND a.sap_created_at <= p.cutoff) AS sap_internal_mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_credit_submitted_at >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_credit_submitted_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_credit_approved_at >= a.account_credit_submitted_at
      AND a.account_credit_approved_at <= p.cutoff) AS credit_approval_valid_pairs,
    AVG(
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        a.account_credit_approved_at - a.account_credit_submitted_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    ) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_credit_submitted_at >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_credit_submitted_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_credit_approved_at >= a.account_credit_submitted_at
      AND a.account_credit_approved_at <= p.cutoff) AS credit_approval_mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_sinosure_start >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_sinosure_start < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_sinosure_end >= a.account_sinosure_start) AS sinosure_term_valid_pairs,
    AVG(
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        a.account_sinosure_end - a.account_sinosure_start
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    ) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_sinosure_start >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_sinosure_start < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_sinosure_end >= a.account_sinosure_start) AS sinosure_term_mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_cda_start >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_cda_start < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_cda_end >= a.account_cda_start) AS customer_cda_term_valid_pairs,
    AVG(
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        a.account_cda_end - a.account_cda_start
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    ) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_cda_start >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_cda_start < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_cda_end >= a.account_cda_start) AS customer_cda_term_mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      a.account_cda_submitted_at >= p.start_date
      AND a.account_cda_submitted_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND a.account_cda_approved_at >= a.account_cda_submitted_at
      AND a.account_cda_approved_at <= p.cutoff) AS customer_cda_approval_valid_pairs
  FROM accounts AS a
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      account_id
    FROM opportunity_rows
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND account_id IS NOT NULL
  ) AS linked
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    24 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('签保密协议平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_cdaenddate－商机.new_cdastartdate，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 保密协议继续使用已确认的商机表独立开始/结束日期。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '商机已确认口径',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
        FROM node_cycle_means AS x
        WHERE
          x.metric_code = 'P0-03'
      ),
      '关联客户日期对照_非替代值',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(d)
        FROM account_time_diagnostics AS d
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P0-03' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P0-04.name: 输入客户需求平均周期
P0-04.definition: 商机.new_approved_time_acneed－商机.new_submit_time_acneed，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P0-04.formula: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P0-04.attributes:

LE01-A0386 商机管理.客户需求审批通过时间（new_approved_time_acneed，空 73.17%）

P0-04.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.started_at >= p.start_date
    AND n.started_at < p.end_exclusive
    AND n.started_at <= p.cutoff AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      AND finished_at <= cutoff
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND entered_at IS NOT NULL
      AND entered_at <= cutoff
      AND (
        finished_at > cutoff OR (
          finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag
        )
      )
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        cutoff - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    in_window
    AND event_id IS NOT NULL
    AND finished_at >= started_at
    AND finished_at <= cutoff AS completed_valid,
    in_window
    AND event_id IS NOT NULL
    AND entered_at IS NOT NULL
    AND entered_at <= cutoff
    AND (
      finished_at > cutoff OR (
        finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag
      )
    ) AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    25 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('输入客户需求平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_approved_time_acneed－商机.new_submit_time_acneed，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 客户需求按自身提交至审批通过；不再从商机创建时间累计。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P0-04'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P0-04' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P0-05.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress

), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (

    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('处理', '待确认直接置空', '用户标注', '待确认：是否要删除') AS detail
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",

  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",

  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
