P3-03.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_quote_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    'QUOTE_OA',
    q.quote_id,
    o.product_type,
    q.submitted_at,
    q.approved_at,
    q.approved_at
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
), review_quote_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.period_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.period_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND r.finished_at <= p.cutoff
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p /* 按红字采用实际起止配对；审批减提交，不取ABS，不回退阶段，不把缺审批时间当0。 */
), review_quote_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_quote_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,
    product_type
), review_quote_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_linked_rows
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    kind
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    44 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P3-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('完成批量报价平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.sample_count > 0 THEN '已按用户红字口径计算' ELSE '口径已修改；所选期间无有效起止配对' END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('报价申请单.new_approved_time－new_oasubmitdate，按报价申请ID去重后取平均，换算天。 通过报价申请明细关联商机，沿用当前最新关联报价申请；按OA审批时间归年/月。只算真实起止，不再回退P3阶段。 按红字启用报价OA周期；与P1-06复用同一计算结果，不读取全空的批量报价确认完成日期。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM review_quote_cycle_stats AS v
        WHERE
          v.kind = 'QUOTE_OA'
      ),
      '输入质量',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(q)
        FROM review_quote_cycle_quality AS q
        WHERE
          q.kind = 'QUOTE_OA'
      ),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN review_quote_cycle_stats AS s
    ON s.kind = 'QUOTE_OA' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P3-04.name: 创建 SAP 客户档案平均周期

P3-04.formula: 仅new_issap=1且SAP基准日期落所选期间。商机createdon＜SAP基准日期时为0天并参与平均；不满足的其他情况暂留空。未进SAP或SAP两日期都空不计入周期。

-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), sap_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.created_at,
    a.sap_registered,
    a.sap_registration_kind,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    COALESCE(a.sap_created_at, a.sap_submitted_at) AS sap_reference_at,
    COALESCE(a.sap_created_at, a.sap_submitted_at) >= p.start_date
    AND COALESCE(a.sap_created_at, a.sap_submitted_at) < p.end_exclusive
    AND COALESCE(a.sap_created_at, a.sap_submitted_at) <= p.cutoff AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), sap_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    CASE
      WHEN sap_registered = '1'
      AND in_window
      AND sap_reference_at IS NOT NULL
      AND created_at < sap_reference_at
      THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM sap_cycle_source AS s
), sap_cycle_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    COUNT(duration_days) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND in_window) AS eligible_window_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND in_window) AS eligible_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days = 0) AS zero_day_opportunities,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND in_window AND duration_days IS NULL) AS remaining_period_rows_left_null,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND sap_reference_at IS NULL) AS registered_without_both_dates_all_linked,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '0' AND sap_reference_at IS NOT NULL) AS not_registered_but_has_date_all_linked,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND in_window AND sap_registration_kind = '1') AS registration_kind_1_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      sap_registered = '1' AND in_window AND sap_registration_kind = '2') AS registration_kind_2_rows
  FROM sap_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    45 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P3-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('创建 SAP 客户档案平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '已执行商机创建早于SAP基准记0天规则；其余周期留空'
      WHEN n.eligible_window_rows = 0
      THEN '所选期间无已进SAP且有基准日期的关联记录'
      ELSE '有符合范围的记录，但其余周期起止未明确，暂留NULL'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('仅客户new_issap=1；SAP基准取COALESCE(new_sapdate,new_sapsubmitdate)，基准落所选期间且不晚于观察截止。商机createdon严格早于基准时按用户规则记0天。其他情况无明确周期起止，暂留NULL，不沿用提交至创建或自行改成建档至签约。按商机－客户关系逐项判断，商机ID去重；0天样本参与均值。new_issapnew的1/2原值分组见明细。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM sap_cycle_summary AS x
    ) AS detail
  FROM sap_cycle_summary AS n
  WHERE
    n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), supplement_order_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY salesorderid
      ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), supplement_order_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    created_at,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at
  FROM supplement_order_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,

  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), review_order_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_type) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(o.product_type)
      ELSE '未唯一识别产品'
    END AS product_type
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), review_order_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    'ORDER_OA',
    s.order_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_type, '未唯一识别产品'),
    s.submitted_at,
    s.approved_at,
    s.approved_at
  FROM supplement_order_latest AS s
  LEFT JOIN review_order_products AS t
    USING (order_id)
), review_order_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.period_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.period_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND r.finished_at <= p.cutoff
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_order_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p /* 按红字采用实际起止配对；审批减提交，不取ABS，不回退阶段，不把缺审批时间当0。 */
), review_order_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_order_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_order_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_order_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_order_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,
    product_type
), review_order_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_linked_rows
  FROM review_order_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    kind
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    47 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P3-06' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('创建批量订单评审平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.sample_count > 0 THEN '已按用户红字口径计算' ELSE '口径已修改；所选期间无有效起止配对' END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('订单.new_approval_time－new_oasubmitdate，按订单ID去重取平均，换算天。 按订单OA审批通过时间筛选年度/月度。订单独立计周期，缺商机关联只影响产品分组，不阻断总体；缺审批或提交时间不回退阶段。 按红字采用订单OA提交至审批耗时。低填充的审批时间不再用订单申请日期或P3阶段代替。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM review_order_cycle_stats AS v
        WHERE
          v.kind = 'ORDER_OA'
      ),
      '输入质量',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(q)
        FROM review_order_cycle_quality AS q
        WHERE
          q.kind = 'ORDER_OA'
      ),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN review_order_cycle_stats AS s
    ON s.kind = 'ORDER_OA' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,

    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,

    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid

    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,

    o.s4,
    o.s5,

    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  o.*,
  v.stage_code,
  v.started_at,
  v.finished_at,
  (
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at, p.cutoff), p.cutoff) - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  ) AS elapsed_days,
  v.started_at >= p.start_date AND v.started_at < p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
  v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at > p.cutoff AS inflight,
  v.started_at IS NULL
  OR (
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at < v.started_at
  ) AS invalid_dates,
  CASE
    WHEN v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at >= v.started_at
    THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      v.finished_at - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  END AS completed_days
FROM opportunity_flags AS o
CROSS JOIN context AS p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('P0', o.created_at, o.s1),
    ('P1', o.s1, o.s2),
    ('P2', o.s2, o.s3),
    ('P3', o.s3, o.s4),
    ('P4', o.s4, o.s5)
) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
WHERE
  v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at <= p.cutoff
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  stage_code,
  product_type,
  AVG(completed_days) AS mean_days,
  COUNT(completed_days) AS sample_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts
WHERE
  in_window
GROUP BY
  stage_code,
  product_type
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  48 AS sort_no,
  CAST('P4-01' AS TEXT) AS code,
  CAST('批量交付阶段平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
  CAST(COUNT(f.completed_days) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
  CAST((
    NULL
  ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
  CAST(AVG(f.completed_days) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
  CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
  CAST('new_stage4enddate→new_stage5enddate；仅完整有效起止样本参与均值及数量；各阶段单独判断，缺结束不以观察截止补齐；按开始时间归期，跨年完成按实际完整周期；不限制当前阶段枚举。' AS TEXT) AS note,
  CAST((
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(t))
      FROM stage_means AS t
      WHERE
        stage_code = 'P4'
    )
  ) AS JSONB) AS detail
FROM stage_facts AS f
WHERE
  stage_code = 'P4' AND in_window
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P4-02.name: 批量交付阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量
P4-02.definition: 按阶段筛出实际周期大于动态平均周期 1.5 倍的商机。以商机 ID 去重后汇总预测金额和电量，细分电芯与 PACK。
P4-02.formula: 只汇总本阶段满足超期条件的商机。同一商机在同一阶段只计算一次。
P4-02.attributes:
LE01-A0007 商机管理.阶段四结束日期（new_stage4enddate，空 87.73%）
LE01-A0151 商机管理.阶段五结束日期（new_stage5enddate，空 99.55%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P4-02.notes: 阶段均值只含完整有效起止的已结束样本，不含在途。超过均值1.5倍的预测量独立统计；在途实际用时仍可按观察截止计算并比较已结束样本均值。
P4-02.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P4-02.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P4-02.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → stage_facts → stage_means → stage_overdue
P4-02.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,

    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  o.*,
  v.stage_code,
  v.started_at,
  v.finished_at,
  (
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at, p.cutoff), p.cutoff) - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  ) AS elapsed_days,
  v.started_at >= p.start_date AND v.started_at < p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
  v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at > p.cutoff AS inflight,
  v.started_at IS NULL
  OR (
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at < v.started_at
  ) AS invalid_dates,
  CASE
    WHEN v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at >= v.started_at
    THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      v.finished_at - v.started_at
    )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
  END AS completed_days
FROM opportunity_flags AS o
CROSS JOIN context AS p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('P0', o.created_at, o.s1),
    ('P1', o.s1, o.s2),
    ('P2', o.s2, o.s3),
    ('P3', o.s3, o.s4),
    ('P4', o.s4, o.s5)
) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
WHERE
  v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at <= p.cutoff
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
  stage_code,
  product_type,
  AVG(completed_days) AS mean_days,
  COUNT(completed_days) AS sample_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts
WHERE
  in_window
GROUP BY
  stage_code,
  product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    m.mean_days,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    f.elapsed_days > 1.5 * m.mean_days AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts AS f
  JOIN stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    49 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('批量交付阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('超过同阶段同产品均值1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', opportunity_id, '产品', product_type, '周期天', elapsed_days, '均值天', mean_days)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P4' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P4-03.name: 订单交付情况平均周期
P4-03.definition: 订单明细逐行new_shipping_return_qty≥quantity，所有明细均已发足才认定整单完全发货；完全发货日期取该订单全部明细new_shipping_time的最大值。周期＝完全发货日期－订单头new_approval_time，换算天后按订单ID去重取平均。
P4-03.formula: 按订单明细主键取最新记录，逐明细比较已发货数量与订单数量，相等也算发足，不跨明细或计量单位直接加数量抵消未发部分。完全发货日期按MAX(new_shipping_time)归年/月；任一明细缺数量、缺主键或缺发货日期时保留未知，不自动回退其他表日期。仅有数量发足证据而没有完整日期时，不计入交付周期均值。
