-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), supplement_order_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY salesorderid
      ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), supplement_order_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    created_at,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at
  FROM supplement_order_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
    CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    CAST(o.new_processstage AS TEXT) AS process_stage,
    CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
    CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
    CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
    CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
    CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
    CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
    CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
    CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
    CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
    CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
    CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
    CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p.cutoff
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AS signed
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
), review_order_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_type) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(o.product_type)
      ELSE '未唯一识别产品'
    END AS product_type
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), review_order_line_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(salesorderdetailid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL) AS order_qty,
    CAST(new_shipping_return_qty AS DECIMAL) AS shipped_qty,
    CAST(new_shipping_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb
), review_order_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      l.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY line_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_order_line_source AS l
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_unkeyed_order_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    order_id
  FROM review_order_line_source
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NULL
), review_order_quantity_status AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      order_qty > 0) AS positive_quantity_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      order_qty IS NULL OR shipped_qty IS NULL OR order_qty < 0) AS missing_or_invalid_quantity_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      shipped_at IS NULL) AS missing_shipping_date_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      shipped_qty < order_qty) AS not_fully_shipped_lines,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        order_qty IS NULL OR shipped_qty IS NULL OR order_qty < 0) > 0
      OR EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM review_unkeyed_order_lines AS u
        WHERE
          u.order_id = l.order_id
      )
      THEN NULL
      ELSE BOOL_AND(shipped_qty >= order_qty)
    END AS completely_shipped,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        shipped_at IS NULL) > 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE MAX(shipped_at)
    END AS fully_shipped_at
  FROM review_order_lines AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(l.order_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), review_full_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    fully_shipped_at
  FROM review_order_quantity_status
  WHERE
    completely_shipped IS TRUE
), review_delivery_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    'FULL_DELIVERY',
    s.order_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_type, '未唯一识别产品'),
    s.approved_at,
    f.fully_shipped_at,
    f.fully_shipped_at
  FROM supplement_order_latest AS s
  JOIN review_full_orders AS f
    USING (order_id)
  LEFT JOIN review_order_products AS t
    USING (order_id)
), review_delivery_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.period_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.period_at < p.end_exclusive
      AND r.finished_at <= p.cutoff
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p /* 按红字采用实际起止配对；审批减提交，不取ABS，不回退阶段，不把缺审批时间当0。 */
), review_delivery_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_delivery_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,
    product_type
), review_delivery_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_linked_rows
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    kind
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    50 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('订单交付情况平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.sample_count > 0 THEN '已按用户红字口径计算' ELSE '口径已修改；所选期间无有效起止配对' END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('订单明细逐行new_shipping_return_qty≥quantity，所有明细均已发足才认定整单完全发货；完全发货日期取该订单全部明细new_shipping_time的最大值。周期＝完全发货日期－订单头new_approval_time，换算天后按订单ID去重取平均。 按订单明细主键取最新记录，逐明细比较已发货数量与订单数量，相等也算发足，不跨明细或计量单位直接加数量抵消未发部分。完全发货日期按MAX(new_shipping_time)归年/月；任一明细缺数量、缺主键或缺发货日期时保留未知，不自动回退其他表日期。仅有数量发足证据而没有完整日期时，不计入交付周期均值。 按客户最新确认，完成状态与日期均取订单明细：已发货数量≥订单数量、全部明细满足，完成时间取MAX(new_shipping_time)。直接实现该方法，不自动改用发货单日期或其他替代方法；订单审批、数量及明细日期缺失时周期仍为NULL。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM review_delivery_cycle_stats AS v
        WHERE
          v.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY'
      ),
      '输入质量',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(q)
        FROM review_delivery_cycle_quality AS q
        WHERE
          q.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY'
      ),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用',
      '订单数量及日期核对',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(q))
        FROM review_order_quantity_status AS q
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN review_delivery_cycle_stats AS s
    ON s.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P4-04.name: 目标达成情况平均周期
P4-04.definition: 按当年月度目标出货电量，与当月实际发货电量按日累计比较。首次累计达到月目标即停止计时；周期＝达成日－当月1日＋1，25日达成记25天。对所选期间可计算月份取平均。
P4-04.formula: 月份按页面年/月选择；月目标沿当前目标表商机＋年度最新版本，取对应月power。实际电量＝发货数量×产品单套kWh÷10^6。未达成计至观察日或月底，并单列在途；目标≤0或核心输入缺失不作有效月份。
P4-04.attributes: LE12-A0005 new_accproducttype、LE12-A0001 new_product_typeid、LE10-A0002 name、LE10-A0001 teamid、LE11-A0003 systemuserid、LE11-A0002 teamid、LE06-A0023 createdon、LE06-A0038 new_account_id、LE06-A0041 new_month1、LE06-A0042 new_month10、LE06-A0073 new_month10_power、LE06-A0043 new_month11、LE06-A0074 new_month11_power、LE06-A0044 new_month12、LE06-A0075 new_month12_power、LE06-A0072 new_month1_power、LE06-A0045 new_month2、LE06-A0076 new_month2_power、LE06-A0046 new_month3、LE06-A0077 new_month3_power、LE06-A0047 new_month4、LE06-A0078 new_month4_power、LE06-A0048 new_month5、LE06-A0079 new_month5_power、LE06-A0049 new_month6、LE06-A0080 new_month6_power、LE06-A0050 new_month7、LE06-A0081 new_month7_power、LE06-A0051 new_month8、LE06-A0082 new_month8_power、LE06-A0052 new_month9、LE06-A0083 new_month9_power、LE06-A0053 new_opportunity_id、LE06-A0054 new_producttype_id、LE06-A0001 new_targetid、LE06-A0056 new_year、LE06-A0016 ownerid、LE06-A0022 owningteam、LE18-A0031 new_system_energy、LE18-A0095 productnumber、LE16-A0034 createdon、LE16-A0036 modifiedon、LE16-A0001 new_ord_shipmentid、LE16-A0017 new_shipping2_date、LE16-A0032 statecode、LE17-A0029 createdon、LE17-A0031 modifiedon、LE17-A0022 new_amount_base、LE17-A0019 new_ord_salesorder_id、LE17-A0003 new_ord_shipment_id、LE17-A0001 new_ord_shipmentitemid、LE17-A0015 new_product_id、LE17-A0012 new_productcode、LE17-A0008 new_qty、LE17-A0004 new_uom_id
P4-04.notes:
用户红字：使用当年月的目标出货量数值，与当年月的出货表实际出货量比较，达到当年月的出货量就停止，比如25号达成目标，则周期时间为25天
处理：按红字采用总体月度出货目标达成天数，不再用P4阶段周期。数量列为有效月份数；达成与未达成分别计数。目标和实绩沿现有GWh换算，不用数量冒充电量。
P4-04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见调用SQL）；已同步红字口径
P4-04.v3Change: 按红字修订同步：实际调用SQL及计算步骤已更新；待确认项保持NULL。
P4-04.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P4-04.ctes: parameters → context → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → review_month_target_facts → review_month_targets → product_codes → review_header_source → review_headers_latest → review_item_source → review_items_latest → review_month_energy_days → review_month_cumulative → review_month_achievement → review_month_days
P4-04.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；默认2025全年；无绑定参数。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(observed_at, CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), review_month_target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh,
    MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) AS target_month
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), review_month_targets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    target_month AS month_start,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_gwh,
    COUNT(*) AS target_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_target_rows
  FROM review_month_target_facts
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    target_month < p.end_exclusive
    AND target_month + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' > p.start_date
    AND target_month <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY
    target_month
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), review_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb
), review_headers_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY shipment_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_header_source AS s
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(shipment_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(new_product_id AS TEXT) AS product_id,
    CAST(new_uom_id AS TEXT) AS uom_id,
    CAST(new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb
), review_items_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      i.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY line_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_item_source AS i
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_month_energy_days AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(h.shipped_at AS DATE) AS shipped_date,
    SUM(i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      i.qty IS NULL OR pc.energy_kwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM review_items_latest AS i
  JOIN review_headers_latest AS h
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    h.statecode = 0
    AND i.qty > 0
    AND h.shipped_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(p.start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
    AND h.shipped_at < p.end_exclusive
    AND h.shipped_at <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY
    CAST(h.shipped_at AS DATE)
), review_month_cumulative AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
    SUM(energy_gwh) OVER (
      PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date)
      ORDER BY shipped_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_gwh
  FROM review_month_energy_days AS d
), review_month_achievement AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    MIN(d.shipped_date) FILTER(WHERE
      d.cumulative_gwh >= t.target_gwh) AS first_achieved_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.missing_energy_rows), 0) AS missing_actual_rows,
    MAX(d.cumulative_gwh) AS known_cumulative_max,
    LEAST(
      CAST((
        t.month_start + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
      ) AS DATE) - 1,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(p.cutoff AS TIME) = CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME)
        THEN CAST(p.cutoff AS DATE) - 1
        ELSE CAST(p.cutoff AS DATE)
      END
    ) AS through_date
  FROM review_month_targets AS t
  LEFT JOIN review_month_cumulative AS d
    USING (month_start)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    t.month_start,
    t.target_gwh,
    t.target_rows,
    t.missing_target_rows,
    p.cutoff
), review_month_days AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CASE
      WHEN target_gwh > 0
      AND missing_target_rows = 0
      AND missing_actual_rows = 0
      AND through_date >= month_start
      THEN CAST((
        COALESCE(first_achieved_date, through_date) - month_start + 1
      ) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    first_achieved_date IS NULL AS not_achieved
  FROM review_month_achievement AS m /* 每月1日起按自然日含首日计数：25号首次达到月目标即25天。未达成算至观察日/月底。 */ /* 目标非正或核心输入不全不编造达成日期；没有该月发货记录按累计0、未达成处理。 */
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    51 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('目标达成情况平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(duration_days) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(AVG(duration_days) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(duration_days) > 0
      THEN '已按月度出货目标达成天数计算'
      ELSE '口径已修改；缺正数月目标或完整电量输入'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('月目标与实际出货电量同为GWh；按自然月累计，首次达到目标即停止计时，25日达成记25天。未达成计至观察日或月底并单列未达成；目标非正/缺值、实际核心输入不全不编造周期。当前按总体月份统计，数量列为可计算月份数，不是商机数。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '逐月明细',
      JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(m)),
      '已达成月份数',
      COUNT(duration_days) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT not_achieved),
      '未达成月份数',
      COUNT(duration_days) FILTER(WHERE
        not_achieved),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用'
    ) AS detail
  FROM review_month_days AS m
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r

BR-Q01.name: 商机预测金额口径
BR-Q01.description: 所选期间内同商机同月按创建 / 修改时间取最新月度预测；只用预测金额 new_forecast_amt_rmb，不混入已历月份实绩；电量 = 预测金额 ÷ new_whprice（元 / Wh）÷ 10^9（GWh）
BR-Q01.result: 金额为空不补 0；SUM 忽略单个 NULL，缺失条数在结果明细；部分合计不代表全量完整

BR-Q02.name: 签单判定
BR-Q02.description: 商机 → 订单明细.new_opportunity_id → 明细.salesorderid → 订单.salesorderid，去重订单数 ≥ 1 为已签单，= 0 为未签单
BR-Q02.result: 不使用订单头 opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举；不额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期（统计关联现状，非历史签单快照）
BR-Q02.action: 未能关联订单的商机按未签单
BR-Q02.relatedElements:
维度：D015 商机签单
实体：LE01 商机管理、LE08 订单产品、LE07 订单
指标：R02、R04、R05、R06、C01、C06
C07、C08、C09

BR-Q03.name: 去重规则
BR-Q03.description:
商机按商机 ID、客户按客户 ID、订单按订单 ID 去重；同一商机在同一阶段只计一次；销售目标必须先按商机ID＋年度去重版本，再展开月份及汇总。同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。
客户名单计数先按储能团队范围筛选，再按客户ID去重；范围规则见BR-Q04。
BR-Q03.result: 目标版本键=COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(new_opportunity_id::text),''),new_targetid::text)＋new_year；ROW_NUMBER按createdon、新目标ID降序，必须先筛rn=1。GROUP BY客户/产品仅汇总，不能去除历史版本。
BR-Q03.relatedElements:
指标：全部计数与汇总指标（按各指标取数对象适用）
实体：LE01 商机管理、LE05 客户、LE07 订单、LE06 销售目标管理
目标关联指标：B01、R01、R03～R06、R08、C03、C05及其目标依赖。

BR-Q04.name: 重点跟踪口径
BR-Q04.description:
战略客户（等级 1）与重点客户（等级 2）的未签单商机均属于重点跟踪；0 核心 / 4 BG 不自动纳入；等级未知不当一般客户
储能客户范围：最新商机负责人ownerid→团队人员systemuserid→团队teamid确定团队；客户owninguser属于这些团队任一人员即纳入。客户不必已有商机，不限客户创建年份；按accountid去重，一人多团队不重复。
BR-Q04.result: 客户等级见 DR04~DR06；客户 SQL parameters.strategic_levels / focus_levels 可调
BR-Q04.relatedElements:
维度：D005 客户等级
指标：R04、C08、C09、C06
储能客户范围适用：R08、R09、C01、C06及R04重点跟踪、C08/C09关联分组。

BR-Q05.name: 金额电量分开判定

BR-Q05.trigger: 全部 R / C 规则
BR-Q05.relatedElements:
风险：RK01、RK02、RK03、RK04、RK05、RK06、RK07、RK10（涉及金额、电量的判定）
根因：RC01、RC03、RC04、RC05、RC06、RC07、RC08、RC09（涉及金额、电量的判定）

BR-Q06.name: 动态平均周期
BR-Q06.description: P0＝createdon→new_stage1enddate；P1～P4＝前阶段结束→本阶段结束。不限制当前阶段枚举；均值及参与数量仅统计完整有效起止且结束不早于开始的样本，缺结束不计该阶段。按进入阶段时间归期，跨年结束按实际周期。总体、电芯/PACK分别计算；在途用时只用于独立风险比较，不计均值。
BR-Q06.result: 单笔周期严格大于同阶段同产品均值 × 1.5 判超期（等于不触发）；日期逆序剔除并计数；同商机每阶段只计一次

BR-Q08.name: 统计期间参数
BR-Q08.description: 客户 SQL 无绑定参数：只改 parameters.start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含，默认 2025 全年）；观察截止 = LEAST(当前时间, 期末)；时间进度 = (观察截止 − 年初) ÷ 全年天数
BR-Q08.result: 年度目标（B01 / C03）不随期间缩为单月
BR-Q08.relatedElements:
指标：全部 51项指标
维度：D001 月度销售预测期间、D029 目标时间

BR-Q09.name: 环节周期自身起止
BR-Q09.description: 阶段内小环节按本环节自身开始、结束事件计算，不以阶段起点代替本环节开始；已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归期；同一事件去重
BR-Q09.result: 独立起止事件未明确的环节主值保持 NULL（P0-05、P0-08、P1-06、P2-05、P3-03、P3-05、P3-06、P4-03、P4-04、S01、S02、S04）；P0-07 暂沿用创建 → 预测完成；P3-04例外，按BR-Q10处理

BR-Q10.name: SAP 建档周期
BR-Q10.description:
仅new_issap=1；SAP基准日期=COALESCE(new_sapdate,new_sapsubmitdate)，须落所选期间且不晚于观察截止。
商机.createdon>SAP基准日期时记0天，其他情况留NULL。
BR-Q10.result: 按商机ID去重、关联客户后逐项判断；0天样本参与平均，NULL不参与。等于、早于及日期缺失均不记0。new_issapnew仅按原始1/2分组。
BR-Q10.relatedElements:
指标：P3-04 创建 SAP 客户档案平均周期
实体：LE01 商机管理、LE05 客户
关联：商机.parentaccountid=客户.accountid
比较：商机.createdon>COALESCE(客户.new_sapdate,客户.new_sapsubmitdate)

BR-Q11.name: 目标与实绩换算
BR-Q11.description:
目标：先筛年度→按商机ID＋年度排列目标版本→仅保留rn=1→展开该版本12个月→按客户、产品或团队汇总。同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。金额new_month1～12按元÷10^8转亿元；电量new_month1_power～12_power按kWh÷10^6转GWh。
实绩沿原口径：发货明细new_amount_base÷10^8；电量＝数量×产品new_system_energy（kWh）÷10^6。
BR-Q11.trigger: B01、R01～R06、R08、C03～C05及其他使用年度目标的指标；C04实绩换算沿原口径。
BR-Q11.result: 目标SQL必须包含ROW_NUMBER按商机＋年度排序及rn=1，再执行SUM。不得只WHERE new_year后全量求和，不按客户或产品去重，不使用new_total_amount。空商机ID按目标ID独立保留；多团队不重复分摊，未分配沿原口径。

实体：LE06 销售目标管理、LE17 发货单明细、LE18 产品物料

AC02.measure: 仅储能客户名单内。对商机数为 0 的战略客户限期建立商机，明确目标产品部、需求调研计划与责任人
AC02.object: 待突破战略客户（R09 清单）
AC02.target: R09 待突破战略客户数降为 0
AC02.acceptance: 逐户建立商机或给出不开拓理由
AC02.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC03.name: 战略客户突破计划
AC03.measure: 仅储能客户名单内。针对战略客户逐户制定突破计划：目标产品部、目标电量、责任人、时间表，跟进无商机战略客户的需求调研与商机建立进度。
AC03.owner: 销售 VP（牵头）＋ 对应产品部总经理
AC03.target: 战略客户覆盖率提升；R09待突破战略客户数下降
AC03.acceptance: 逐户计划齐全并按月更新
AC03.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC06.name: 方案推动超期项目优先排资源
AC06.action: 方案推动超期项目优先排资源
AC06.measure: 对 P2 在途超期商机优先排技术资源，补齐技术协议、规格书、质保协议等输入，逐项关闭卡点
AC06.object: 方案推动超期商机（C07 清单）
AC06.target: C07 超期商机数下降；P2-02 超期预测量下降
AC06.acceptance: 每条超期商机卡点关闭或给出新的完成时间
AC06.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC07.name: 产品部缺口分解与资源倾斜
AC07.action: 产品部缺口分解与资源倾斜
AC07.measure: 按产品部分解销售缺口，资源优先保障缺口最大的产品部，并匹配同部门待签商机
AC07.object: 销售缺口为负的产品部
AC07.acceptance: 各产品部缺口与对应待签商机逐项对账
AC07.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC08.name: 纳入月度经营对账
AC08.measure: 将产品部达成率与战略客户商机推进率纳入月度经营分析对账
AC08.target: 月度对账覆盖全部产品部
AC08.acceptance: 月度经营分析会输出对账结论
AC08.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC09.name: 电芯 / PACK 待签逐单转化
AC09.action: 电芯 / PACK 待签逐单转化
AC09.measure: 对待签集中的产品类型（电芯 / PACK）逐单制定转化计划：预计签约时间、责任人、所需支持
AC09.object: 待签占比 ≥ 20% 的产品类型商机
AC09.target: R05 / R06 待签金额下降
AC09.acceptance: 逐单转化计划齐全并按周更新
AC09.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC10.name: 扩大重点跟踪纳管
AC10.measure: 将战略、重点客户未签单商机全部纳入重点跟踪，使重点跟踪占未签单预测 ≥ 70%
AC10.object: 战略、重点客户未签单商机
AC10.acceptance: 重点跟踪清单覆盖全部战略、重点客户未签单商机
AC10.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC11.name: 其余商机需求确认专项
AC11.action: 其余商机需求确认专项
AC11.measure: 对重点跟踪以外（一般客户）的未签单商机中 P0 需求未确认的商机，逐条确认需求与预计签约时间
AC11.target: C06 需求未确认商机数降为 0
AC11.acceptance: 每条商机完成需求确认或关闭
AC11.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

AC12.name: 商机获取环节卡点清理
AC12.action: 商机获取环节卡点清理
AC12.measure: 定位商机获取阶段超期的具体环节（保密协议、客户需求、协作团队、需求输入、销售预测、客户组织架构），逐环节指定责任人并补录环节事件
AC12.object: P0 超期商机（P0-02 清单）
AC12.owner: 销售负责人 ＋ 销售运营
AC12.target: P0-02 超期商机预测量下降；P0-05 / P0-08 完成事件可计算
AC12.acceptance: 超期环节逐项关闭；环节事件补录完整
AC12.method: 根因成立后按模板生成，AI 补充具体对象、数字与时间（数字须来自指标结果）

customerTier.statusReason: 本体客户等级映射已确认；本体未提供战略客户名单工作表

strategic.expression: account.new_accountlevel = '1'（客户 SQL parameters.strategic_levels，默认 ['1']，可调）

priority.expression: account.new_accountlevel = '2'；重点跟踪 = 战略 + 重点（parameters.focus_levels 默认 ['1','2']）

general.expression: 其余等级（含 0 核心、4 BG、3 一般及空）；0 核心 / 4 BG 不自动纳入重点跟踪（客户 SQL 口径）

source.definition: 0 核心 / 1 战略 / 2 重要 / 3 一般 / 4 BG 大客户 → 三档：战略、重点、一般

strategicList.reason: 本体只有按客户等级的派生规则，未提供战略客户名单

dynamicCycle.sample: 单笔周期严格大于同阶段同产品均值 × 1.5 判超期（等于不触发）；日期逆序剔除并计数；同商机每阶段只计一次

storageCustomerScope.rule: 储能客户范围：最新商机负责人ownerid→团队人员systemuserid→团队teamid确定团队；客户owninguser属于这些团队任一人员即纳入。客户不必已有商机，不限客户创建年份；按accountid去重，一人多团队不重复。

electricitySource.reason: 本体 BR-Q01：预测电量 = 预测金额 new_forecast_amt_rmb ÷ new_whprice（元/Wh）÷ 10^9（GWh）；new_forcastpower 实库为空，new_orderforecast_qty 是预测订单出货数，不能作为电量。

recentActivity.description: 无商机战略客户在本体定义的近期窗口内存在线索、线索进展、客户拜访或最新销售活动时，不认定开拓不足。

RK07.decision: RK07 只关联 RC09，解除 RK07 与 RC01 的矛盾关联
RK07.reason: RK07 客户无商机，不能同时要求存在该客户的 P0 商机。

excluded.reason: 投标部分暂时从销售额口径明细卡片删除（2026-11-12 用户指示）
